args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

@gideon.sato Going by this channel: your first report of the kiosks offline on 3 Aug was at 10:42 AM ("gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant... Guard is writing trailer numbers on a clipboard"). Your 11:08 AM post says both lanes were working as of 11:07 AM.

For the guard in between, the only account here is your 10:42 post: he was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM post says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Nothing in this channel says what the guard did after that. I only checked this channel, so if you reported it earlier somewhere else, that won't show here.

Your first report of the kiosks offline on 3 Aug was at 10:42 AM in #inc-vtg-hartford. Both lanes were back as of 11:07 AM.

At 11:03 Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back, the guard checked in trailer 8836, and dispatch could see it. The channel doesn't say what the guard did after that.
